notes.title: Free Chess 2.0
notes.content:
[h1]This update is huge![/h1]

If you liked Free Chess before you're going to love the improvements we are bringing to 2.0

[h2]-Single player:[/h2]
First things first, we heard your requests for a single player option so here it is!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/2183d186b1331dce64c1cf4d5cd3b85e9648f848.png[/img]

The option to player single player has now been implemented and you will have the option to play true solo, where you can plan out matches with yourself without interruptions, or go head to head with a bot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/ba9c3551a4f58675aad597ab72303d5d1a8c1f5a.png[/img]

We have also added a slider to the difficulty of said bot, but be warned, even at the lowest difficulty, beginners may find it very challenging, but Free Chess allows even the worst players of chess the ability, to cheat... That's right, we believe that the concept behind Free Chess has always been about the unrestricted option of being able to play how you want. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/2c4302ac3bafd34e20818cbe6d198d01235a9f83.png[/img]
The AI is represented by this robot hand and will move pieces just like you would. *It was a really awesome feeling to see this guy finally functioning 100% moving stuff around!*

Also, Yes, you can checkmate the bot on the hardest difficulty in the first turn, or you can simple remove several pieces at a time. Play however you like!

[h2]-New Maps:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/184ea4ed410f9b875709f87eb607bb9c00cafa87.png[/img]

With the addition of AI single player, we have also implemented maps to come with various DLC sets for those wanting fresh environments to play in.

[h2]-Movement Guides:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/e6564437bf50e916ecafbae5b3bc51cf7790b355.png[/img]

We love the idea of letting players move however they like, but after joining a few matches, we realised there are some out there who have no idea how pieces move.
Our Movement Guides are just that, and can be completely ignored if you wanted to chea.. I mean, play differently.

Here are some examples of said guide.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/98c3dccb63a5680fb41b89a06321d45ca62a5be8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/f374bab224fd7dee1bcfd373f27ab6092b7bdd9d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/e86e780ea28d2a3db015b285f6cc2e001ab34a56.png[/img]

As you can see, pieces are shown all the available tiles they can move and even the pieces they can take.

This also applies to the most important piece in the most important stance, Check!

When a king is in check, the guide will show you all the possible safe locations for the king to move into, so no more having to gesture where the king can move.

[h2]-King Check & Check Mate:[/h2]

With our guides we have also implemented a visual Check icon to show players when a King is in Check.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/42c1d932c7d23171319247756af81ae757cec4b0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/02d75460ea6067f7e7ab9a7068796bcd199e6de9.png[/img]

This system also enables players to see when they are in Check Mate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/ff1eec1882f527b4e22aa9c29f894c59d9723978.png[/img]

[h2]-Game Clock:[/h2]

We heard a few of you wanting the ability to play with a chess clock, so we added it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/736f60c1405f029d77cfc473472e586b891d3563.png[/img]
This clock is currently locked at 10 minutes per player. At the end of each players turn the clock will pause and start counting down for the player who's turn it is and so on.

[h2]-Win Lose Game Clock:[/h2]

We finally have a way to show when a player has become victorious!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/1cb2c4c507c42bb21cd70d595e7ffef977eab8ab.png[/img]
With the clock we have a way to see which side has won, this will trigger when the timer counts down to 0, scoring the win to the player with time remaining on the clock, or to the first player to Check Mate the other player. Despite the game being over, you will have the option to continue playing.

To reset the game, simply pause (esc) and hit restart (Host player only).

[h2]-Grid Numbers:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/1f7ee7e8ec2683ff9c49286fad115262ca5e3a77.png[/img]
This one might not seem like much, but calling out where to move stuff with friends is hard without the grid, so here it is!
Note: the grid numbers and letter will move based on the camera allowing the easiest readablity.

[h2]-View pieces:[/h2]

This update came before 2.0, but I thought this would be a good spot to remind everyone this feature exists.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/6b698893f2a3389b9f6bd91cf86e83729b060530.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/d575d7e0a749c33b2f74ec4fba6a7618a1c57f3e.png[/img]
Some of our DLC pieces may confuse players on the first time seeing them, so we want to make sure players always know there is a way to identify what is on the table (or off) at all times by holding CTRL on the keyboard.
This feature also shows player names on the correct player hands, in case you have too many hands flying around during a game.

notes.title: Free Chess nearing completion
notes.content:
[h1]Free Chess Inbound[/h1]

We have been working in every bit of spare time we have to bring this awesome chess game to you all, but it hasn't been a smooth ride the whole time, so we figured we could share some of the ups and downs we've had so far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/39923b280d62ec572eea45b6c1235c31d5a692a0.gif[/img]

[h3]What is this game?[/h3]

So most of you are probably reading this thinking, what the heck is this game and why should I care about it? Well long story short, we love table top games and love to make digital games, chess just happened to be a good little project for us to work on while experimenting with some ideas. 
Instead of your standard chess game where you are locked in to moving only where pieces are meant to move, Free Chess allows you to move your pieces however you like. 
Knock down you opponents pieces, or even move their pieces for them!
This will allow players to play chess like they would in person.

We know this type of chess gameplay won't be for everyone, but that's why we are making it free!
When it comes out, give it a go and if worst comes to worse, it wasn't your jam, but you gave it a whirl.
With any luck, you will have a super fun time and see why we had to make it this way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/af075fc298eb6f8f3a8299d360b1c579c7b0c9bf.png[/img]

[h3]Bug fixing[/h3]

We've been doing a lot of testing, tweaking, rebuilding and retesting over the past month (I forgot to mention this game has had about 6 week development to date), this has allowed us to really break the game and find what works and what doesn't.

Our beta testing has been within a relatively small select group, but even so, we managed to find some pretty interesting bugs.

-Fixed pieces getting stuck in air when another player picks up a piece while you have one selected
-Fixed Multiplayer lag on all pieces other then hosts.
-Fixed Hands not picking up pieces or rotating based on players camera rotation
-Fixed manually engaging server on/off mode.
-Fixed Table flip not flipping
-Fixed Level not loading
-Fixed long list of issues that made the game unplayable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/d76ed99462cd5663339737fce9ced36354524635.png[/img]

[h3]Polish[/h3]

-Added Menu beauty (Custom game auto plays while camera slowly orbits)
-Added selecting pieces in menu which displays them on the show board.
-Added selecting boards in menu which displays on the show board.
-Added core game play features...

Technically this isn't a bug report, considering this is the first announcement and before now there was no game. But we just wanted to make it clear that we are doing our best to deliver a finished product on launch and not something that is bug ridden and unplayable!

We will however keep a close ear to the ground in case other find bugs we missed after launch and be sure to post here once we fix anything!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975275/593a75dc7b03803404cb8b07884fd5c0b84bd250.gif[/img]

So all in all, things are looking very good and we are hoping to release very soon, so why not Wishlist us and give the game a go on launch!

As always, Stay Awesome Everyone,
-VidovicArts
